_comment: Jacquard cosim harness for the C64 tapeout chip_top (WS-P2-6 / task 8). Boots the C64 from the external QSPI flash ROM + PSRAM on the post-PnR netlist (final/pnl/chip_top.pnl.v). Shared QSPI bus: SCK=bidir_PAD[34], SIO[3:0]=bidir_PAD[35..38] shared by both memories; PSRAM on CS bidir_PAD[33], flash on CS bidir_PAD[39]. GPIO indices below are logical handles mapped to top-level pad ports via port_mapping (build_gpio_mapping resolves the gf180 bi_24t CORE2PAD/PAD2CORE split). NOTE: both memories share clk_gpio=34 + d0_gpio=35 with distinct csn — depends on the GPU kernel arbitrating din to the CS-selected instance only (open verification). Flash modelled writable=true (functionally a read-only PSRAM per ADR 0005) so it can enter QPI + serve 0xEB reads; the controller never writes it. Video-streaming tap (signal_streams) added once boot is confirmed.
_comment_clocks: clk32 is an ON-DIE derived clock: a dffrnq_1 toggle FF (Q = i_chip_core.c64_u.buslogic.clk, D = ~Q via inv_1, clocked by the clk_PAD tree) divides the 64MHz pad clock by 2 to make the 32MHz C64 system clock. Cosim cuts the divider and schedules clk32 as a commensurable /2 domain (gpu-eda/Jacquard#185). Net is named as it appears in the flat post-PnR netlist, minus the escape backslash.
_comment_video: Video-streaming tap (gpu-eda/Jacquard#184): emits one byte per pixel (colorIndex[3..0], hsync, vsync packed LSB-first) on enablepixel strobe, over a UNIX socket. Render with docs/spikes/video-streaming-tap/c64_video_renderer.py. Net names verified against the post-PnR netlist.
